Home · Services · Skin Boosters

Treatment

Skin Boosters

Small injections designed to improve skin hydration and texture.

About the treatment

Skin boosters place small amounts of a product, often based on hyaluronic acid, within the skin. They are used to address hydration and texture. The ingredients and injection method depend on the product chosen.

If your skin feels dry or looks dull despite a regular routine, we can assess the cause and discuss whether a booster is an appropriate option.

At a glance

  • Treatment focused on skin hydration
  • May improve texture and elasticity
  • Options for fine lines and dullness
  • Areas chosen according to the product and assessment
  • A plan focused on skin quality

The treatment process

  1. Consultation and assessment. We assess your skin, review previous treatments and discuss the proposed product.
  2. A personal plan. We explain the treatment options, likely results, possible side effects and cost before you decide.
  3. The treatment itself. We talk you through the session and check how you feel as we go.
  4. Aftercare and follow up. We explain how to care for the treated area and when to contact us or return for a review.

Expected results

Changes in hydration and texture may develop over the following weeks. The timing and extent depend on the product, treatment area and your response.

Recovery & downtime

Small bumps, redness, swelling or bruising can occur at the injection sites. We will explain how long these may take to settle and give you advice on makeup, exercise and skincare afterwards.

Who is it for?

Boosters may be considered for dryness, dullness or fine texture changes. A consultation helps us check suitability and discuss whether skincare or another treatment would be a better starting point.

Frequently asked questions

How are skin boosters different from filler?
Filler is usually used to add volume or shape in a specific area. Skin boosters are used more broadly for hydration and texture. The product and technique matter, so we will explain what the proposed treatment is intended to do.
When will I see the result?
Changes may appear gradually over the first few weeks. We will discuss the expected timing for your product and review your response before planning further sessions.
Where can boosters be used?
Depending on the product and your assessment, areas may include the face, neck, upper chest or hands. Ask about the specific area you would like to treat.
